about.title: Novato Slip & Fall and Premises Liability Claims
about.longDescription: Novato's mix of shopping centers along Redwood Boulevard, residential complexes near San Marin Drive, and businesses off Novato Boulevard means daily foot traffic across a wide range of properties. When a property owner or manager fails to address a spill, broken walkway, poor lighting, or loose flooring, the result can be a serious fall injury. California law requires the injured person to show that the owner knew, or reasonably should have known, about the hazard and didn't fix it or warn visitors. That's why documenting the scene and requesting any nearby surveillance footage matters early, before it's deleted or overwritten. LawProactive isn't a law firm — we're a free service that connects Novato residents and visitors with an independent attorney who can evaluate what happened, gather evidence, and explain your options. There's no cost to you unless your attorney recovers compensation on your behalf.

whyChoose.title: What Matters in a Novato Premises Case

items.title: Proving Notice
items.desc: California requires showing the property owner knew or should have known about the hazard and didn't correct it or post a warning. An attorney can help gather maintenance logs, complaint history, and inspection records to support this.

items.title: Preserving Surveillance Video
items.desc: Many Novato retailers and apartment complexes have security cameras, but footage is often overwritten within days or weeks. Acting quickly to request preservation can be critical to your claim.

items.title: Understanding Comparative Fault
items.desc: California uses pure comparative fault, meaning your compensation can be reduced by your percentage of responsibility but isn't automatically barred. An attorney can help address any arguments that you were partly at fault.

items.question: How long do I have to file a slip and fall claim in Novato?
items.answer: Generally, California gives you two years from the date of the fall to file a lawsuit against a private property owner. If a government entity is involved, such as a fall on public property, the deadline is much shorter and requires an early claim. It's best to speak with an attorney as soon as possible to avoid missing any deadline.

items.question: What should I do right after a fall at a Novato business or apartment?
items.answer: Take photos of the hazard, the surrounding area, and your injuries if you're able. Report the incident to the property manager or staff and ask for a copy of the report. Try to get contact information from any witnesses, since memories and available footage fade quickly.

items.question: Does it matter that Novato sees more crashes on Thursday afternoons?
items.answer: That pattern relates mostly to vehicle collisions on corridors like US-101 and Novato Boulevard, not indoor or premises falls. Still, busier commercial areas during peak hours can mean more foot traffic and potentially more fall hazards going unnoticed. An attorney can look at the specific conditions at the time of your fall regardless of the day.
